population_rule: count/retained_mass only by counting or summing over already-committed artifacts (source named per entry); PENDING otherwise; interpretation_change in {yes,no,unknown} — unknown is a legal answer

entries.reason: cascade impact decays 0.20 at depth-1, 0.04 at depth-2, dropped at depth-3+ (CASCADE_D1_DECAY/CASCADE_D2_DECAY)
entries.count_note: depth-3+ drops are not persisted; committed supply-chain edge list = 19 edges (counted from v3/signal/supply_chain.py, 2026-08-07)
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to CASCADE_D1_DECAY, CASCADE_D2_DECAY, or the depth cutoff

entries.reason: bundled evidence snapshot caps each name at 100 evidence objects (PER_NAME_CAP, mirrors render_why_json limit)
entries.count: 5 of 79 names at the 100-object cap (counted over committed docs/why/*.json, 2026-08-07)
entries.retained_mass_note: pre-cap totals are not persisted at generation
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to PER_NAME_CAP, or >20% of names at cap

entries.reason: U350 shadow drain processes at most DRAIN_CAP=12 filings per run and only when U79 queues are empty (shadow starves first, by design)
entries.count_note: drain backlog lives in the u350 DB schema, not a committed artifact
entries.interpretation_change_note: structurally isolated shadow surface; U79 canonical surfaces read nothing from it (U350 isolation gate proves refusals by attempt each build)
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to DRAIN_CAP or to the starvation order

entries.reason: C7 peer-correlation component is STRUCTURALLY_INACTIVE (needs 20d sector-cohort return correlations not yet in production inputs)
entries.count: structural: all issuer-days while inactive (whole component)
entries.retained_mass: 0 of C7's designed contribution; composite renormalizes over active components
entries.interpretation_change_note: disclosed wherever C7 status appears; composite reads as ex-C7
entries.rerun_threshold: C7 activation or any renormalization change

entries.reason: forward windows enter matured panels only at closure; open windows are excluded from matured statistics, never padded
entries.count_note: derivable by subtraction from committed docs/validation.html forward panel (total signals 4743 at 2026-08-06; per-horizon matured columns printed per label row)
entries.interpretation_change_note: maturity lag is printed on the page (one trading day behind the snapshot record)
entries.rerun_threshold: any horizon change or any padding/backfill of an open window

entries.reason: universe membership changes must invoke the corporate-action policy; affected spans are excluded, never silently spliced
evidence-tier names are never scored: positive gating plus a standing negative check
entries.count: 53 evidence-tier names vs 79 scoring names (counted from the committed tier registry, 2026-08-07)
entries.retained_mass: 0 scored mass from evidence-tier names (by design)
entries.interpretation_change_note: boundary is the published coverage statement itself
entries.rerun_threshold: any tier migration in either direction

entries.reason: extraction failures drop filings from the event stream by family: parse failure, refusal, timeout/retry exhaustion (MAX_RETRIES)
entries.count_note: failure logs are operational, not committed artifacts
entries.rerun_threshold: a new failure family, or any family exceeding 5% of intake in a week

entries.reason: scoring-universe names with stale latest prices are flagged by the U2 delisting watch and excluded from fresh panels until resolved
entries.count: 0 stale of 79 (universe-gate run of 2026-08-07: 79/79 fresh within 5 trading days)
entries.rerun_threshold: any name flagged by the delisting watch

entries.reason: No.5 ingestion refuses any (source, series_id) outside the enumerated 11-series set ALL_SERIES (6 FRED + 3 EIA + 2 yfinance); licensed LSEG/Bloomberg factor sets excluded per the No.5 packet
entries.count_note: 11 series in-set counted from ALL_SERIES (2026-08-10); 5 ingested this session, 6 FRED pending FRED_API_KEY; the excluded licensed class is not enumerable
entries.rerun_threshold: any edit to FRED_SERIES / EIA_SERIES / YF_SERIES / ALL_SERIES

entries.reason: bounded backfill: observations before BACKFILL_START (2016-01-01) are never stored; window enforced client-side for every source because the EIA v2 seriesid route ignores start/end and returns full history
entries.count_note: one counted example from the 2026-08-10 smoke overshoot (deleted before backfill): EIA PET.RWTC.D full history 10219 rows, 2652 in-window retained; per-series pre-2016 drop counts are not persisted
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to BACKFILL_START or the client-side window filter

entries.reason: source-native absent observations are skipped, never stored as zeros: FRED value '.', EIA null value, yfinance NaN close
entries.count_note: skips are not persisted; dominated by non-trading days (weekends/holidays) in daily series
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to the '.'/null/NaN skip branches

entries.reason: a per-series fetch failure skips that series for the run (printed to stderr, nonzero exit; next --accrue or --resume self-heals) rather than aborting the whole ingestion
entries.count_note: 0 error-branch activations across the 2026-08-10 smoke (x3), backfill, and resume runs (counted from run stats)
entries.rerun_threshold: any change to the error-branch semantics (skip vs abort) or exit-code contract
